pr_title: ttl: use JobRegistry.UpdateJobWithTxn to avoid race condition
pr_body:
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/85800

UpdateJobWithTxn updates the job progress with useReadLock=true to prevent
concurrent update attempts from undoing each other.

Release justification: Fix test flake.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/86322)
I separated this out of https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/86057 to make reviewing easier as the original PR began to address multiple issues.
